The fixed-parameter calculations compare the two AMP fits at common conditions, replay the two MDEA liquid splits and test the aqueous reference conventions in MEA. The pressure and pH comparisons use their stated observation bases. The phase searches address the finite trials and phase supports recorded for each state.
